summary: Iteration 7: Testing 3 new features - 1) Search bar in My Books, 2) Manage Series dialog with expandable series view and add books from within, 3) Auto-read ON by default and narrator voice dropdown in BookReader. All features verified working. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Search bar exists in My Books page with placeholder 'Search your books...'
Search filters books by title, description, or genre (filteredBooks logic in Dashboard.js)
Manage Series dialog shows series list with book counts
Each series has chevron down icon for expand/collapse
Clicking series row expands to show books in series with order numbers
Expanded series shows book cover thumbnails (or placeholder icon)
Expanded series shows 'Add a book to this series' dropdown select
Can add a book to series from within expanded series view
X button visible to remove book from series
Series badge visible on book cards in My Books (with series name and order number)
Empty search state shows 'No books found' message
Clear Search button clears search input
Auto-Read is ON by default in BookReader (autoRead state initialized to true)
Narrator voice dropdown visible in reader bottom controls (Select component with voices)
Voice dropdown shows 22 available narrator voices (Rachel, Domi, Bella, Antoni, etc.)
Fullscreen button visible in reader header
Volume slider and Speed slider visible in bottom controls
Books in series show order number badge (e.g., #2)
Series API returns books array for expandable view
Book API returns series_id and series_order fields for badge display
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test books
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features working: 1) Search bar in My Books - filters by title/description/genre, shows 'No books found' empty state with Clear Search button. 2) Manage Series dialog - expandable series view shows books with order numbers, thumbnails, Edit button, X remove button, and 'Add a book to this series' dropdown. Chevron icons toggle expand/collapse. 3) BookReader has Auto-Read ON by default (autoRead state = true), narrator voice dropdown in bottom controls shows 22 voices (Rachel default), volume slider, speed slider (1x), fullscreen button in header.
